name: Saimin Mesu Dorei Kishi Sofia ~Lez Kishi Danchou, Saimin Choukyou ni Ochiru~
original_name: 催眠牝奴隷騎士ソフィア ～レズ騎士団長、催眠調教に堕ちる～
source:
The kingdom is protected from demons' attacks by the knights led by Sofia and the mage Rick.
But Sofia clearly hates Rick and shows it so much, that when they are asked to become more friendly, he decides to take decisive action.
Using hypnosis and dark magic, he will turn her into his sex slave.
translation:
索菲亚率领的骑士团与魔法师里克共同守护王国，抵挡恶魔进攻。

然而，索菲亚显然十分厌恶里克，而且毫不掩饰。后来，有人要求两人改善关系，里克便决定采取果断手段。

他将运用催眠与黑魔法，把索菲亚变成自己的性奴。
